desc:
⛏️ Mine down, find eggs, hatch animals and get rich!

Break the layers with your pickaxe, find caves full of eggs, and bring them back to your base to hatch. Your animals earn cash every second!

🥚 20 zones with rarer eggs the deeper you go
⛏️ 15 pickaxes to unlock
🎒 Upgrade your backpack to carry more eggs
🌈 Events give eggs rare mutations
🎁 Daily rewards and free gifts

How deep can you go?
